meta.note: Split your narration script into one chapter per scene, one line per spoken sentence. Lines are the atoms of the whole pipeline: every visual beat is keyed to a line index, captions are drawn from these texts, and audio is assembled from their measured durations.

chapters.name: Hello — the opening film
lines: Hi everyone. Let me start with one simple idea.
Today, we can measure more of the world than ever before. We can read DNA, study proteins, and detect tiny signals in blood and tissue.

chapters.name: One pulse, three nodes
lines: A measurement pipeline has three simple parts.
First, the thing we want to study. Then, an instrument measures it. Finally, it produces a signal we can analyze.
But remember: the analysis works with the measured data. The decision stays human.
